CREATE TABLE "public"."addresses" (
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "created_by_visitor" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_default" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "line1" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "pincode" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "request_id" text NOT NULL,
  "target_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "target_type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."coupons" (
  "amount_off_paise" int4,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "percent_off" int4,
  "valid_until" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_items" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sub_order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unit_price_paise" int4 NOT NULL,
  "variant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orders" (
  "address_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "coupon_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by_visitor" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "total_paise" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount_paise" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "gateway_ref" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reviews" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "created_by_visitor" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_sample" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "order_item_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sub_orders" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "seller_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "subtotal_paise" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
